instructions: This is a harmless tool protocol compatibility test. Do not run real commands. Produce exactly one tool call. Do not answer with prose.

tools.name: functions
tools.description: Tools for code execution, local commands, file editing and task reading.

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run JavaScript to compose tool calls. text(value) emits output. The host exposes tools.exec_command, tools.apply_patch and tools.mcp__codex_app__read_thread. For this protocol test, call text("TOOL_PROBE_OK"); only. No actual commands are executed.

format.definition:
start: pragma_source | plain_source
pragma_source: PRAGMA_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE
plain_source: SOURCE
PRAGMA_LINE: /[ \t]*\/\/ @exec:[^\r\n]*/
NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
SOURCE: /[\s\S]+/

tools.name: js
tools.description: Fallback protocol probe. Use only if the exec tool is unavailable.

input.content: Call functions.exec with the exact JavaScript text("TOOL_PROBE_OK");. If exec is absent from the available callable tools, call mcp__cua_repl.js with code NO_EXEC. Do not choose probe_json.
